cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Refining & Downstream lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +4.25%; weakest is Refining & Downstream at -8.11%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.body: Leaders: EOSE +12.96%, LEU +11.59%, FLNC +10.18%, UUUU +9.27%, UEC +8.06%. Laggards: ENPH -17.30%, VLO -9.39%, DINO -9.04%, MPC -7.67%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
